comment: The DSP is the Symbiote alternative firmware for Warps, itself an evolution of Parasite, vendored at alt_firmware/symbiote; src/mutuus.cpp is the Rack wrapper, running one modulator per polyphonic channel. Four of its nine modes are new against Distortiones — a dual state variable filter, an ensemble chorus, a collection of four stereo reverbs taken from Rings, Clouds and Elements, and a delay — and the original cross-modulation set survives as Meta mode. An extra button, ST, switches the dual filter mode to stereo. The level jacks carry two normals each in effect: mutuus.cpp:193 reads the first with getNormalVoltage(5) for the gain and mutuus.cpp:227 reads the same jack again with getNormalVoltage(2) for the internal oscillator's pitch. Per-channel reads use getVoltage(channel) rather than getPolyVoltage(channel), so a monophonic cable patched to a control voltage jack drives the first channel alone; the MODE jack is the exception and is read four channels at a time.
